name: What should a hotel look for when choosing a water damage restoration company?

mainEntity.name: What should a hotel look for when choosing a water damage restoration company?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a water damage restoration company for a hotel, prioritize experience and specialized expertise in commercial properties. Look for companies with 24/7 emergency response capabilities, as speed is crucial. Ensure they are certified by organizations like the IICRC (Institute of Inspection, Cleaning and Restoration Certification), indicating adherence to industry standards. Verify they are fully licensed and insured, and ask for references from other commercial clients. Transparent communication, a clear restoration plan, and the ability to work discreetly are also important factors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for experience with commercial properties, 24/7 emergency response, IICRC certification, proper licensing and insurance, and transparent communication.
